rule: 16-d surface descriptors (embedding_1) of the official search model, mean over the surface points nearest to each residue
inputs_passed: all atoms of the structure file with hydrogens added by reduce (elements and coordinates); residue identity enters through side-chain atoms
pose: principal-axis pose of the CA trace with fixed axis signs, applied before hydrogens are added
pooling: masked mean over all residues of the chain
structure_coverage: every row has a structure file whose sequence equals the task sequence (see manifest/coverage.csv)
